The derivation tree of a scenario set

Source: R/structure.R
lineage.Rd

Each scenario records the plan it was derived from in @parent_id; a ScenarioSet is where enough of those plans sit together for the edges to be drawn. One row per scenario, pointing at its parent within the set and carrying what changed against it. A scenario whose parent is not in the set is a root here — lineage as far as the set records it.

Usage

lineage(set)

Arguments

set

A ScenarioSet.

Value

A data frame with one row per scenario:

scenario, id, parent_id

Its label and identity.

parent

The label of its parent in the set; NA for a root.

depth

0 for a root, parent's depth + 1 otherwise.

status, revision, spend

The scenario's own.

spend_vs_parent, spend_pct_vs_parent

Against its parent; NA for a root.

Details

The baseline is not privileged: compare_scenarios() measures every scenario against the baseline, this measures each against the plan it actually came from. On a set built by deriving from the base they agree; on a chain — base, a scenario from it, a scenario from that — they do not, and this is the one that reads as a tree.

See also

plan_mermaid(), compare_scenarios()

Examples

base <- media_plan_from_df(
  data.frame(channel = c("TV", "Search"), planned_spend = c(80, 40)),
  grain = "channel", name = "base"
)
s1  <- build_scenario(base, c(Search = 60), name = "Search up")
s2  <- build_scenario(s1, c(TV = 70), name = "and TV down")
set <- add_scenario(add_scenario(scenario_set(base), s1), s2)
lineage(set)
#>      scenario                         id                  parent_id    parent
#> 1        base plan_20260909171949_95c3ff                       <NA>      <NA>
#> 2   Search up plan_20260909171949_09fda0 plan_20260909171949_95c3ff      base
#> 3 and TV down plan_20260909171949_7463a2 plan_20260909171949_09fda0 Search up
#>   depth         status revision spend spend_vs_parent spend_pct_vs_parent
#> 1     0                       1   120              NA                  NA
#> 2     1 in development        1   140              20          0.16666667
#> 3     2 in development        1   130             -10         -0.07142857
